Job Description:
Role Summary
Nariana Enterprises Ltd. is seeking an experienced
Procurement Officer – Construction
to support procurement activities within the Civil Engineering Department.
The successful candidate will be responsible for sourcing and purchasing construction materials, equipment, tools, spare parts, consumables, and services while ensuring competitive pricing, correct specifications, timely delivery, and proper procurement documentation.
The role requires someone with strong supplier sourcing, negotiation, purchasing, cost control, and supplier management skills, together with a practical understanding of construction and project-based procurement.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable dealing directly with suppliers, project teams, site personnel, LPOs, quotations, price comparisons, delivery documentation, and project procurement records.
Key Responsibilities
Civil Engineering Procurement & Purchasing
Receive and process approved purchase requests from construction sites and company departments.
Source construction materials, consumables, spare parts, tools, equipment, services, and other project related requirements.
Obtain quotations from multiple suppliers and prepare quotation analysis and price comparison sheets.
Negotiate supplier prices, discounts, credit terms, payment terms, and delivery schedules.
Prepare and process Local Purchase Orders (LPOs) and related procurement documentation.
Ensure purchases comply with approved specifications, quantities, budgets, and project requirements.
Coordinate urgent and emergency site purchases where required.
Follow up with suppliers to ensure materials and equipment are delivered within agreed timelines.
Coordinate with Project Managers, Engineers, Quantity Surveyors, Storekeepers, and site teams to confirm material requirements before purchasing.
Verify stock availability and existing orders before making purchases to minimize unnecessary or duplicate procurement.
Maintain procurement trackers for pending orders, deliveries, supplier commitments, and outstanding documentation.
Supplier Management & Cost Control
Identify, evaluate, and maintain relationships with reliable and competitive suppliers.
Maintain an updated database of approved and potential suppliers.
Continuously source alternative suppliers to improve pricing, availability, and supply reliability.
Negotiate favourable commercial terms while maintaining required quality and specifications.
Monitor supplier performance in relation to pricing, quality, reliability, responsiveness, and delivery.
Monitor prevailing market prices for commonly purchased construction materials and equipment.
Compare supplier pricing against historical purchases, project budgets, and prevailing market rates.
Identify and report significant price increases, unusual purchasing trends, excessive material requirements, or potential cost concerns.
Continuously identify opportunities for cost savings without compromising required quality or project specifications.
Support management in controlling procurement and material costs across civil engineering projects.
Procurement Documentation & Controls
Check supplier invoices against approved quotations, LPOs, delivery notes, and goods/services received.
Ensure all procurement documentation is complete before submission to the Finance Department for payment.
Maintain organised records of quotations, comparison sheets, LPOs, delivery notes, invoices, and supplier correspondence.
Assist with supplier account reconciliations and outstanding payment queries where required.
Ensure all purchases follow company procurement procedures, approval processes, and authorised limits.
Maintain proper records of materials purchased and delivered to individual construction projects.
Ensure procurement documentation is properly filed, accurate, and easily traceable.
Escalate pricing discrepancies, delivery delays, specification issues, documentation gaps, or supplier concerns promptly.
Coordination & Reporting
Work closely with the Procurement Manager, Finance Department, Project Managers, Engineers, Quantity Surveyors, Storekeepers, site teams, and suppliers.
Provide regular updates on pending purchases, outstanding deliveries, supplier issues, and urgent site requirements.
Track procurement requirements separately for each construction project.
Support project teams in monitoring purchases against approved project budgets and BOQs.
Help improve internal procurement systems, supplier tracking, and purchasing controls.
Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling supplier quotations, pricing information, company records, and project information.
Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate should have:
Diploma or Degree in
Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Purchasing, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum 3–5 years of relevant procurement or purchasing experience.
Previous experience working in a construction, contracting, civil engineering, building-materials, or project-based company will be strongly preferred.
Practical experience purchasing construction materials, tools, equipment, spare parts, consumables, or project-related services.
Good understanding of procurement procedures, supplier sourcing, quotation analysis, and LPO preparation.
Strong supplier negotiation and price comparison skills.
Ability to understand technical descriptions, specifications, quantities, and construction material requirements.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and general procurement systems.
Experience working with quotations, LPOs, delivery notes, invoices, supplier statements, and procurement trackers.
Key Skills & Competencies
Construction procurement and purchasing.
Supplier sourcing and vendor management.
Strong negotiation and commercial skills.
Quotation analysis and price comparison.
Cost control and market price awareness.
Good knowledge of construction materials and project purchasing.
Strong Microsoft Excel and reporting skills.
Excellent documentation and record keeping skills.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to verify specifications, quantities, pricing, and delivery requirements.
Strong organisational and time management skills.
Ability to manage procurement requirements for multiple projects simultaneously.
Ability to work under pressure and respond to urgent site requirements.
Strong communication and supplier-management skills.
High level of integrity, accountability, and confidentiality.
Practical, proactive, and problem solving mindset.
Candidate Profile
The successful candidate should be confident dealing directly with suppliers, negotiating prices and commercial terms, comparing quotations, preparing LPOs, and following up deliveries.
The right candidate should understand the importance of cost control, competitive sourcing, correct specifications, proper documentation, and timely procurement within a construction environment.
Candidates who have previously handled procurement for
c
ivil engineering, road works, building works, contracting, construction materials, or other project-based operations will have a strong advantage.

Job Description:
Role Summary
Nariana Enterprises Ltd. is seeking an experienced
Senior Accountant – Construction
to support the financial management and accounting functions of the Civil Engineering Department.
The successful candidate will be responsible for
f
inancial reporting, project accounting, budgeting, statutory compliance, reconciliations, cash flow monitoring, cost control, and internal financial controls.
The role requires someone with strong practical accounting experience, excellent knowledge of Tally ERP, and a good understanding of construction or project-based accounting.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable independently preparing management accounts, reviewing project costs, managing reconciliations, monitoring receivables and payables, supporting audits, and identifying financial or cost control concerns for management.
Key Responsibilities
Accounting & Financial Reporting
Maintain complete and accurate accounting records using Tally ERP.
Lead the monthly accounting close process and ensure all transactions are recorded within the correct reporting period.
Prepare monthly management accounts, including Profit & Loss Statements, Balance Sheets, Cash Flow Reports, and supporting schedules.
Maintain and review the general ledger, journals, cost centres, and project-wise accounting records.
Prepare and post accruals, prepayments, depreciation, provisions, and other month end adjustments.
Prepare and review monthly balance sheet reconciliations and ensure outstanding items are investigated and cleared promptly.
Ensure income, expenses, assets, liabilities, and project costs are correctly classified and allocated.
Maintain accurate supporting schedules for key balance sheet and Profit & Loss accounts.
Prepare periodic financial reports and analysis to support management decision making.
Accounts Payable & Supplier Management
Review supplier invoices against approved quotations, LPOs, delivery notes, and supporting documentation.
Ensure supplier payments are supported by complete and properly authorised documentation.
Review supplier statements and reconciliations before payments are processed.
Monitor supplier balances, outstanding invoices, credit notes, advances, deposits, and payment commitments.
Maintain and review accounts payable ageing reports.
Work closely with Procurement to resolve pricing, quantity, documentation, or supplier-account discrepancies.
Ensure supplier accounts are accurate and properly reconciled.
Accounts Receivable & Collections
Maintain accurate customer accounts and receivable records.
Prepare and review accounts receivable ageing reports.
Monitor overdue customer balances and follow up internally on outstanding collections.
Maintain schedules of outstanding invoices, certified works, retentions, and expected collections where applicable.
Ensure receipts are correctly allocated to customer and project accounts.
Investigate and resolve discrepancies in customer balances and receivable records.
Provide management with regular updates on overdue receivables and expected cash collections.
Project Accounting & Cost Control
Maintain accurate project-wise cost accounting for all civil engineering projects.
Ensure expenditure is allocated to the correct project, cost centre, and expense category.
Prepare project cost reports showing budgeted costs, actual expenditure, committed costs, and variances.
Monitor actual project expenditure against approved budgets and BOQs.
Review project expenses and identify abnormal expenditure, cost overruns, duplicate charges, incorrect allocations, or expenditure outside approved budgets.
Monitor project advances, site expenses, retentions, outstanding certificates/invoices, and other project related balances where applicable.
Work closely with Project Managers, Quantity Surveyors, Procurement, Stores, and site teams to reconcile project expenditure and material costs.
Highlight significant project cost variances and financial risks to management.
Support management in evaluating the financial performance and cost position of individual projects.
Budgeting, Cash Flow & Financial Planning
Assist in preparing annual, departmental, and project budgets.
Prepare and regularly update cash-flow forecasts based on expected collections, supplier payments, payroll, statutory obligations, and project requirements.
Prepare budget versus actual reports and investigate significant variances.
Monitor upcoming financial commitments and advise management on anticipated cash requirements.
Support management in prioritising payments based on cash availability, project requirements, and supplier obligations.
Monitor bank balances and ensure major expected inflows and outflows are reflected in cash flow forecasts.
Tax & Statutory Compliance
Manage VAT, withholding tax, PAYE, and other applicable statutory accounting requirements.
Ensure timely and accurate preparation and submission of statutory returns.
Maintain proper supporting documentation and schedules for statutory and tax filings.
Monitor statutory deadlines and ensure compliance with applicable requirements.
Assist with tax reconciliations and resolution of statutory discrepancies.
Liaise with auditors, tax consultants, and relevant authorities where required.
Fixed Assets & Company Records
Maintain and periodically reconcile the fixed asset register.
Ensure additions, disposals, transfers, and depreciation of company assets are accurately recorded.
Maintain supporting documentation for fixed assets.
Coordinate with relevant departments to verify major plant, machinery, vehicles, and equipment recorded in the accounts.
Audit & Internal Controls
Coordinate with external auditors and prepare required schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents.
Respond to audit queries and assist in resolving outstanding audit matters.
Ensure financial records are complete, accurate, and audit-ready.
Review accounting processes and recommend improvements to strengthen internal controls.
Ensure proper segregation of duties, authorisation procedures, documentation, and financial approval processes are followed.
Identify accounting irregularities, control weaknesses, unusual transactions, or financial risks and escalate them promptly to management.
Support payroll accounting, payroll reconciliations, and statutory payroll deductions where required.
Team Support & Reporting
Review accounting work prepared by junior Accounts staff where applicable.
Provide guidance on reconciliations, accounting entries, documentation, and financial procedures.
Ensure monthly reporting, reconciliation, audit, and statutory deadlines are met.
Work closely with Management, Finance, Procurement, Project Managers, Quantity Surveyors, Engineers, Stores, and site teams.
Provide regular updates on cash flow, receivables, payables, project expenditure, statutory obligations, and other key financial matters.
Help improve internal systems for project accounting, expense monitoring, financial reporting, and cost control.
Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling company financial and project information.
Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate should have:
Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification, or advanced progress towards completion, is highly preferred.
Minimum 5–7 years of relevant accounting experience.
At least 3 years in a senior accounting role or a position with a similar level of responsibility.
Strong practical and hands-on experience using Tally ERP is essential.
Previous experience working in a construction, civil engineering, contracting, engineering, building-materials, or project-based company will be strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of financial reporting, management accounts, budgeting, taxation, cash-flow management, and accounting controls.
Practical experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, supplier reconciliations, and bank reconciliations.
Strong experience in month end and year end closing procedures.
Good understanding of accruals, prepayments, depreciation, provisions, and balance-sheet reconciliations.
Experience preparing and analysing management accounts, budgets, cashflow forecasts, and variance reports.
Good understanding of project accounting, cost-centre accounting, and project cost control.
Experience preparing or reviewing accounts payable and accounts receivable ageing reports.
Experience coordinating external audits and preparing audit schedules.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
Experience supervising or reviewing the work of junior Accounts staff will be an added advantage.
Key Skills & Competencies
Strong practical knowledge of Tally ERP.
Financial reporting and management accounts.
Month end and year end closing.
General ledger and balance sheet management.
Project accounting and cost-centre accounting.
Construction and project cost control.
Budgeting and cash flow forecasting.
Accounts payable and accounts receivable.
Supplier, customer, and bank reconciliations.
VAT, withholding tax, PAYE, and statutory compliance.
Audit preparation and coordination.
Fixed asset accounting.
Strong Microsoft Excel and reporting skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to identify financial discrepancies, unusual transactions, and cost concerns.
Strong organisational and time-management skills.
Ability to work independently and meet reporting deadlines.
High level of integrity, accountability, and confidentiality.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Candidate Profile
The successful candidate should be highly comfortable working with Tally, management accounts, project costs, supplier accounts, customer accounts, reconciliations, statutory requirements, cash-flow forecasts, budgets, and audit requirements.
The right candidate should be able to identify cost concerns, financial discrepancies, reporting issues, and control weaknesses early and communicate them clearly to management.

Support the consistent implementation of People policies, processes and procedures across the organisation.

Support managers in addressing employee concerns and performance issues early and consistently.
Provide guidance on the interpretation and application of People policies and processes.
Support employee relations processes including investigations, disciplinary matters, grievances and other workplace matters where required.
Identify and escalate emerging people risks and recommend appropriate interventions.
Support organisational and team changes, ensuring that People processes and employee communication are appropriately managed.
Provide coaching and guidance to managers to strengthen people management capability.

Support talent and succession planning activities, including the coordination and tracking of development actions.

Assist with identifying capability gaps and appropriate development interventions.

Maintain and report on key People metrics including headcount, employee movements, turnover, leave, recruitment, performance and other relevant indicators.
Analyse People data and identify trends, risks and areas requiring management attention.
Ensure People data across HR systems, payroll records and reporting tools is accurate and consistent.
Support monthly, quarterly and ad hoc People reporting requirements.
Provide managers and the People & Culture team with reliable data to support decision-making.
Maintain relevant People trackers and ensure actions and deadlines are followed through.

Coordinate and help facilitate People & Culture programmes, workshops, surveys and other employee initiatives.

Work with managers and employees to support effective implementation of People & Culture priorities.

Support the implementation and improvement of HR systems, workflows and People processes.
Ensure People processes are implemented in line with internal policies and applicable employment requirements.

Project planning and design
Support in the planning for and Design of the project hygiene and sanitation initiatives and methodology.

Design and develop relevant specifications for hygiene and sanitation including standard operating procedures (SOPs), design reports, technical specifications.

Documentation of lessons learnt and good practices.

Ensure laid down SOPs, technical, health and safety standards are adhered to in all projects.
Fundraising and networking
Support in the development of technically sound proposals.
Uphold good relations of project stakeholders including the contractors, suppliers, site committees and clients.
Engage actively in relevant clusters and networks.

Co-ordinate and network with the relevant County Government ministries and departments, Community based organizations, Faith based organizations and NGOs and other relevant departments in providing technical support and assistance to WASH activities.
Liaise directly with communities, and community structures on hygiene and sanitation issues as well as other agencies (particularly those carrying out similar activities) regularly to ensure coordination and effective implementation of activities through guidance of the Supervisor/FC.

Support development, monitoring and evaluation WASH project indicators and standards.
Provide regular update reports on hygiene and sanitation activities and program progress against work plan as maybe required.

Experience in community engagement approaches, participatory approaches, and community negotiation
Excellent verbal and written communication skills

We are seeking a results-oriented

to ensure that our professional training programs consistently meet high standards of quality, relevance, participant experience, and measurable learning impact.
The role will be responsible for establishing and managing the organization's training quality framework, monitoring participant and client feedback, evaluating trainers and programs, overseeing learning assessments, supporting accreditation compliance, and measuring the effectiveness of training interventions.

Key Responsibilities

Establish clear quality standards for classroom, virtual, customized, and corporate training programs.
Monitor training delivery against approved course outlines, learning objectives, participant expectations, and organizational standards.
Conduct periodic observations and audits of training sessions.
Identify quality gaps and coordinate corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure consistency in training quality across trainers, courses, locations, and delivery formats.
Participant Experience & Feedback
Design and manage participant evaluation and feedback systems.
Review participant feedback following every training program.
Track participant satisfaction, facilitator ratings, content relevance, venue experience, learning experience, and overall program performance.
Identify recurring participant concerns and recommend improvements.
Work with relevant teams to ensure participant issues are addressed quickly and appropriately.
Develop dashboards and reports highlighting participant experience trends.
Trainer Quality Monitoring
Develop trainer evaluation criteria and performance benchmarks.
Track trainer ratings and performance trends across assignments.
Identify trainers requiring coaching, development, recognition, or further review.
Work closely with the Trainer & Talent Development Manager to improve trainer quality.
Support observation and evaluation of new trainers before or during initial assignments.
Learning Assessment & Outcomes
Develop appropriate mechanisms for measuring participant learning.
Support the use of pre-training assessments, post-training assessments, quizzes, practical exercises, projects, case studies, and competency evaluations.
Measure knowledge and skill improvement where appropriate.
Ensure assessments are aligned with defined learning objectives.
Work with trainers and instructional designers to improve assessment quality.
Learning Impact Measurement
Develop frameworks for evaluating the effectiveness and workplace impact of training programs.
Measure training outcomes beyond participant satisfaction.
Support follow-up evaluations to determine whether participants are applying acquired knowledge and skills.
Work with corporate clients to identify relevant learning impact measures.
Apply recognized learning evaluation approaches such as the
Kirkpatrick Model
where appropriate.
Support measurement of training effectiveness, behavior change, business impact, and return on training investment.
Course & Curriculum Quality
Review course outlines, learning objectives, training materials, assessments, facilitator guides, and participant materials for quality and consistency.
Ensure training content remains practical, relevant, current, and aligned with workplace needs.
Work with subject matter experts and instructional designers to address content quality gaps.
Recommend course updates based on participant feedback, industry developments, and client requirements.
Accreditation & Compliance
Support compliance with relevant training, accreditation, certification, and regulatory requirements.
Maintain appropriate quality documentation and evidence required by accrediting or regulatory bodies.
Support preparation for audits and accreditation reviews.
Monitor compliance with internal policies, trainer requirements, attendance records, assessments, certificates, and learning documentation.
Data, Reporting & Insights
Develop quality and learning impact dashboards.
Produce monthly and quarterly reports on training quality.
Analyze participant feedback, trainer ratings, course performance, complaints, assessments, and learning outcomes.
Identify trends and translate data into practical recommendations.
Present quality insights to management and relevant departments.
Maintain accurate records and documentation of quality improvement initiatives.
Continuous Improvement
Lead initiatives aimed at improving training quality and participant experience.
Work cross-functionally with Learning Solutions, Trainer Management, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, and Management.
Conduct root-cause analysis when quality issues arise.
Track improvement actions to completion.
Benchmark organizational learning practices against leading professional training providers.
Key Performance Indicators
Success in this role will be measured through indicators such as:
Overall participant satisfaction score
Average trainer rating
Net Promoter Score or equivalent participant recommendation metric
Percentage of programs meeting defined quality standards
Participant complaint rate
Complaint resolution and corrective-action rate
Pre- and post-training learning improvement
Course quality scores
Client satisfaction levels
Trainer quality improvement
Accreditation and compliance performance
Percentage of programs evaluated for learning impact
Repeat training and client retention indicators linked to training quality
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Education, Learning & Development, Monitoring & Evaluation, Quality Management, Organizational Development, Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related discipline.
At least
4–6 years of relevant experience
in training quality assurance, learning and development, monitoring and evaluation, customer experience, education, or professional training.
Demonstrated experience analysing feedback, learning outcomes, or service quality data.
Experience in a professional training organization, consultancy, university, corporate academy, or learning and development environment will be an advantage.
Knowledge of learning evaluation frameworks and adult-learning principles is highly desirable.

Training quality assurance
Learning evaluation and impact measurement
Monitoring and evaluation
Data analysis and interpretation
Report writing
Quality improvement
Participant and client experience management
Learning assessment
Attention to detail
Problem solving
Root-cause analysis
Stakeholder management
Strong written and verbal communication
Analytical thinking
Continuous improvement mindset

Job Description:
Role Outline
The Customer Service Lead is expected to lead the end-to-end customer order-to-delivery interface for transport operations by coordinating order execution, distributor engagement, driver deployment and cross-functional service recovery. This role ensures reliable, accurate and timely deliveries, transparent customer communication and disciplined performance improvement to strengthen customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
About the role key duties and responsibilities
Own end-to-end execution of confirmed customer orders from receipt through dispatch, delivery confirmation and closure.
Validate order information and coordinate accurate order entry, updates and authorized modifications with the client customer service team.
Translate customer priorities into executable delivery plans with clear cut-off times, sequencing and service commitments.
Maintain real-time visibility of order and delivery status, escalating risks before customer commitments are missed.
Coordinate dispatch readiness, delivery documentation and proof-of-delivery completion.
Reconcile open, failed or incomplete deliveries and drive each item to documented closure.
Ensure order-to-delivery activities comply with agreed customer procedures, controls and service standards.
Act as the principal operational contact for key distributors on order status, delivery schedules, availability constraints and service exceptions.
Build trusted, professional relationships through accurate information, reliable follow-through and proactive communication.
Capture distributor requirements and recurring service concerns, then coordinate practical responses with the relevant teams.
Proactively identify delivery risks, delays, shortages and distribution constraints and initiate service-recovery actions.
Lead structured root-cause reviews for material or recurring failures and assign corrective and preventive actions.
Escalate critical service risks with clear impact, ownership, recovery plan and decision requirements.
Verify that corrective actions are sustained and reflected in improved delivery outcomes.
Align daily order priorities, delivery schedules and customer communications with the client customer service team.
Coordinate drivers against the delivery plan and provide clear route, timing, documentation and customer-service expectations.
Monitor delivery execution and intervene promptly when performance deviates from agreed standards.
Maintain an accurate performance view covering order accuracy, delivery timeliness, customer experience, driver execution and issue resolution.
Prepare concise performance reports that explain trends, root causes, operational risks and required management actions.
Lead improvement initiatives that simplify process flow, reduce lead time and improve reliability and customer experience.
Standardize successful practices and track improvements to ensure gains are sustained.
About you
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in customer service, logistics or supply chain operations, including responsibility for order-to-delivery execution and customer-facing service management.
Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
Demonstrated experience coordinating large-scale delivery operations, working with key distributors and managing service priorities across customer service, transport operations and drivers.
Working knowledge of structured problem solving, performance reporting and continuous improvement methods.
Supply chain, transport or logistics industry experience, with practical exposure to customer service and distribution operations.
National business knowledge and the ability to work effectively across diverse cultural and stakeholder environments.
What we offer
DHL Supply Chain has a truly international, Inclusive, and diverse working environment, with a strong emphasis on values and team-based leadership along with an open and engaging company culture.
Extensive learning and development opportunities.
Health insurance cover - Inpatient / Outpatient / Dental / Optical.
Tools for the assigned tasks and results delivery.
Company Address: The United Mall, along Kisumu- Kakamega Highway
Company Details: DHL Supply Chain, part of the DHL Group, is the worlds leading logistics provider. Combining management and value-added services with our customized, integrated logistics solutions drives resilience, efficiency, improves quality and creates competitive advantage.

Job Description:
Purpose for the Job
The job holder will provide dedicated day-to-day leadership of the Tax Section, with full accountability for tax compliance, reporting, planning, and related finance operations. The role is responsible for ensuring adherence to all applicable tax laws and regulations, overseeing timely and accurate tax filings, managing tax risks, and providing strategic tax guidance to support the organisation's objectives.
Duties and Responsiblities
Tax Compliance: Ensure timely and accurate filing of all statutory tax obligations (Corporation Tax, VAT, PAYE, Withholding Tax, Excise Duty, and other applicable levies) in line with the Income Tax Act, VAT Act, Tax Procedures Act, and Finance Act updates.
Tax Reporting: Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual tax reports and reconciliations for management and Group reporting, including tax provisions and effective tax rate analysis.
Tax Refunds and Offsets: Prepare and follow up on tax refund and offset applications with KRA (including PAYE and WHT credit offsets), tracking approvals through to utilisation.
TIMS Management: Oversee full compliance with the Electronic Tax Invoice Management System (eTIMS), including invoice validation, exception resolution, and staff guidance on eTIMS requirements.
Transfer Pricing Management: Maintain transfer pricing documentation and policies for intra-group transactions, ensuring compliance with Kenyan transfer pricing rules and OECD guidelines, and support related-party benchmarking.
Tax Planning and KRA Audit Management: Provide proactive tax planning input to minimise tax exposure within the law, and manage KRA audits, queries, and objections, including liaison with tax advisors where required.
Forecast Management Develop and maintain tax and cash flow forecasts to support liquidity planning and timely settlement of tax obligations.
Budgeting: Support preparation of the departmental and tax-related budget, monitor actual performance against budget, and report variances.
Key Competencies
Strong technical tax knowledge with the ability to interpret and apply statutory changes.
High attention to detail and accuracy in reporting and reconciliations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly for legacy balance and credit validation issues.
Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, including liaison with KRA and exteal advisors.
Leadership and team management ability to run the tax section independently.
Proficiency in ERP/accounting systems and MS Excel; familiarity with eTIMS platforms.
High level of integrity and confidentiality given the sensitivity of tax and financial data.
Knowledge And Skills Required
The job holder must possess the following skills.
Sound working knowledge of the Income Tax Act, VAT Act, Tax Procedures Act, Finance Act, and eTIMS requirements.
Experience in the insurance, financial services, or audit firm will be an added advantage.
Prior exposure to transfer pricing documentation and KRA audit management is highly desirable.
Minimum 5–7 years' progressive experience in tax and financial accounting, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or section-head capacity.
Professional and Academic Qualifications
The job holder must possess the following qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
CPA(K) or ACCA fully qualified; a professional qualification/certification in Taxation is an added advantage.
Prior exposure to transfer pricing documentation and KRA audit management is highly desirable.

Plant Operations & Process Control
Supervise daily solvent extraction operations from preparation/flaking through extraction, de-solventizing, solvent recovery and oil/meal handling.
Monitor critical process parameters including temperature, pressure, flow, level, throughput and equipment performance.
Maintain stable plant operations to achieve production, oil recovery, solvent efficiency and quality targets.
Monitor extraction efficiency and identify areas of process loss.
Identify process abnormalities early, troubleshoot issues and take corrective action to minimize downtime and losses.
Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving plant efficiency and process performance.
Shift & Team Management

Ensure effective shift handovers and communication of outstanding operational issues.

Maintain strong operating discipline and escalate significant process, equipment or safety issues appropriately.

Ensure strict compliance with safety requirements, particularly relating to hexane and other flammable solvent handling and hazardous areas.
Monitor solvent leakage, vapour and abnormal solvent losses.
Ensure compliance with PPE, Permit-to-Work, LOTO, housekeeping and emergency-response requirements.
Ensure safe isolation and preparation of equipment before maintenance work.
Coordinate with QA/QC to ensure extracted oil and meal meet approved quality specifications.
Investigate process, quality and safety deviations and implement corrective actions.
Maintenance Coordination & Reporting
Monitor plant equipment condition and coordinate corrective action with Maintenance.
Support shutdowns, preventive maintenance and safe preparation of equipment for maintenance.
Participate in investigation of recurring equipment and process failures.
Maintain accurate production, process, breakdown, safety and quality records.
Prepare accurate shift reports and communicate key plant deviations and corrective actions to management.
Requirements
Qualifications & Experience
Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Food Science/Food Technology, Oilseed Technology, Process Technology, Production/Manufacturing Engineering or another related technical discipline.
5–8 years' relevant experience in solvent extraction, vegetable oil manufacturing, oilseed processing or edible oil production.
Hands-on experience with hexane-based solvent extraction is mandatory.
Previous experience supervising operators or production teams within a process plant environment is preferred.
Willingness to work in shifts is required.
Technical Competencies
Candidates should demonstrate practical knowledge of:
Oilseed preparation and flaking.
Cooking and conditioning.
Extractor operations.
Miscella systems.
De-solventizing and toasting.
Evaporation and condensation.
Solvent recovery.
Crude oil and meal handling.
Pumps and heat exchangers.
Steam systems.
Instrumentation.
Basic PLC/DCS operations.
Process troubleshooting.
Preventive maintenance.
Hazardous-area safety.
LOTO and Permit-to-Work systems.

Drive improvement in MTBF, MTTR, plant uptime and equipment reliability.
Prepare maintenance KPIs, downtime analysis, maintenance reports and continuous improvement plans.

Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution; OR
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering supported by strong relevant plant maintenance and equipment reliability experience.
5–8+ years' relevant mechanical maintenance experience within a process plant environment.

Experience within Animal Feed, Solvent Extraction, Oilseed Processing, Edible Oil or similar process manufacturing environments will be a strong advantage.

Candidates should demonstrate strong hands-on knowledge of:
Rotating equipment.
Pumps, gearboxes and bearings.
Conveyors and material-handling systems.
Hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
Equipment installation and alignment.
Fabrication and welding.
Preventive and predictive maintenance.
Breakdown troubleshooting and RCA.
Critical spare-parts planning.
Maintenance planning and scheduling.
Contractor and technical-team supervision.
Plant shutdown management.
Maintenance cost control.
LOTO and Permit-to-Work requirements.

Quality Assurance (QA) Officer
to join our call center team. The main responsibility of the QA Officer will be to
listen to and evaluate customer calls made by Sales Representatives
, ensuring that agents follow the approved sales process, communicate professionally, provide accurate product information, and maintain the required standards of customer service.
The QA Officer will regularly review recorded calls, identify mistakes or areas of improvement, score agents according to the company's quality standards, and provide clear feedback to supervisors and management.

Listen to recorded calls made by Sales Representatives and evaluate their performance.
Assess calls using the company's approved QA scoring sheet.
Check whether agents follow the correct sales script and procedures.
Evaluate how agents introduce themselves and communicate with customers.

Check whether agents properly understand and address customer questions or concerns.
Identify misleading, inaccurate, inappropriate, or unauthorized statements made during calls.
Check whether agents follow the correct sales and order-taking procedures.
Monitor whether agents properly confirm customer information and orders.
Identify calls where important information has been missed or incorrectly communicated.
Score calls fairly and consistently based on established QA standards.
Prepare daily and weekly QA reports.
Highlight strong-performing agents and identify agents who require additional coaching.
Share quality findings with Supervisors and Management.
Work together with Supervisors and Trainers to improve agent performance.
Provide constructive feedback based on call evaluations.

Recommend areas where additional training may be required.
Conduct random call audits to ensure consistent performance.
Maintain confidentiality of customer information and company data.
Ensure QA evaluations are objective, accurate, and free from personal bias.
Escalate serious violations or repeated issues to the Supervisor or Manager.

Proper greeting and introduction.
Professionalism and communication.
Following the approved sales script.
Knowledge of company products.
Accuracy of product information provided to customers.
Ability to identify and understand customer needs.
Handling of customer questions and objections.
Sales technique and closing ability.
Proper order confirmation.
Accuracy when capturing customer details.
Compliance with company policies and procedures.
Customer service and overall customer experience.

Any statements or practices that may negatively affect the company or customers.

Excellent listening and communication skills.
Strong attention to detail.
Good understanding of sales and customer service processes.
Ability to identify mistakes and inconsistencies quickly.
Strong analytical and reporting skills.
Ability to give constructive and professional feedback.
Good computer skills and ability to work with spreadsheets and call-recording/CRM systems.

Job Objective:
The Stock Assistant will support the effective management of warehouse, stores and office stock operations within a telecommunications environment. The role is responsible for assisting with the receipt, inspection, storage, picking, issuing, dispatch and reconciliation of telecoms equipment, consumables and related materials, including items such as network components, customer-premises equipment, cables, routers, spares and accessories. The postholder will help maintain accurate inventory records across NetSuite and other approved systems, ensuring that physical stock movements are captured promptly, discrepancies are escalated, and stock is handled in line with company procedures, audit requirements, health and safety standards, and operational service-level expectations.
Reporting Line:
Senior Stock Controller
Key Duties & Responsibilities
Receiving and Unloading:
Receive and offload incoming deliveries safely, ensuring goods are handled with due care to prevent damage to equipment and associated materials
Verify all inbound deliveries against purchase orders, delivery notes, packing slips and approved requisitions before accepting stock into the warehouse
Inspect received items for visible damage, shortages, incorrect specifications, serial-number mismatches or other discrepancies, and escalate exceptions promptly
Record received stock accurately and timeously in NetSuite and any other approved inventory platform, ensuring serialised and high-value equipment is fully traceable
Storage and Organization:
Store equipment, spares and materials in designated locations, ensuring appropriate labelling, segregation, accessibility and protection from avoidable damage
Apply appropriate stock-rotation principles, including first-in, first-out (FIFO), and ensure obsolete, damaged, returned or quarantined items are clearly identified
Maintain a clean, safe, well-organised and audit-ready stores environment in line with warehouse housekeeping and 5S principles
Picking, Packing and Issuing:
Pick stock accurately against approved requests, work orders or transfer instructions, verifying item codes, quantities, serial numbers and destination details
Pack equipment securely for internal issue, field deployment, customer delivery or courier dispatch, using suitable packaging to protect sensitive telecoms assets
Prepare accurate tags, labels, serial-number records, dispatch documentation and handover documents for equipment stored, issued or transferred through the warehouse
Dispatch, Returns and Logistics Support:
Assist with issuing, dispatching and transferring stock to requesters, field teams, project teams, suppliers and other approved stakeholders
Ensure outbound orders are complete, correctly documented and dispatched within agreed timelines to support operational continuity and service delivery
Coordinate courier collections, delivery bookings and relevant logistics arrangements, ensuring proof-of-dispatch and proof-of-delivery records are retained
Inventory Control and Record Accuracy:
Support regular cycle counts, spot checks and scheduled stocktakes, ensuring physical counts are accurately captured and reconciled against system records
Investigate variances by checking stock movements, locations, receiving records, issue notes and system transactions, escalating unresolved discrepancies to the Senior Stock Controller
Maintain accurate and up-to-date inventory records, including receipts, issues, transfers, returns, RMAs, serial numbers, locations and supporting documentation
Administrative Duties:
Support general office administration by handling relevant calls, emails, correspondence, deliveries and package distribution in a professional and responsive manner
Monitor office and warehouse consumables, raise replenishment requests when required, and support cost-conscious usage of supplies
Assist with meeting, conference and office set-up requirements, including the movement, preparation and return of relevant equipment or supplies
Liaise effectively with Finance, Operations, Field Services, Procurement, IT, Logistics and other internal teams to support timely stock availability and accurate record-keeping
Provide practical support to new employees, visitors and internal stakeholders where stock, equipment, office access or administrative assistance is required
Warehouse Compliance, Safety and Continuous Improvement:
Maintain warehouse housekeeping standards and actively apply 5S principles to promote safety, efficiency, stock visibility and audit readiness
Comply with company policies, standard operating procedures, health and safety requirements, asset-control processes and audit standards
Ensure RMAs, returns, faulty items, third-party equipment and quarantine stock are logged, labelled and reported to the Senior Stock Controller for appropriate action
Tasks may include prolonged sitting, standing, walking, stair climbing, bending, kneeling, reaching, twisting, carrying and lifting materials in accordance with safe manual-handling practices
Minimum Qualifications
Grade 12 / Matric or an equivalent qualification is required
A certificate or Diploma in warehousing, inventory management, logistics, supply chain, stores management or a related field would be advantageous
Ability to perform physical warehouse tasks, including bending, kneeling, stooping, reaching, twisting, carrying materials and lifting stock safely as required
Strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail and discipline in following documented stock-control procedures
Basic computer literacy, including confidence using Microsoft Office, inventory systems, ERP platforms, warehouse systems, barcode scanners or similar stock-control tools
Clear communication skills and the ability to engage professionally with internal teams, suppliers, couriers and other stakeholders
A valid driving license is desirable
Experience & Skills
At least 2 years’ relevant experience in stock control, stores, warehousing, logistics, inventory administration or a similar operational support role
Understanding of warehouse processes, including receiving, binning, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, stocktaking, cycle counts and discrepancy resolution
Experience capturing stock movements and maintaining accurate records in ERP, inventory or warehouse management systems; experience with NetSuite would be advantageous
Ability to work independently, follow instructions accurately, prioritise routine tasks and collaborate effectively within a fast-paced operational environment
Practical problem-solving ability, reliability, accountability and a strong commitment to inventory accuracy, safety, service delivery and continuous improvement

Company Details: The Mater Hospital was opened in 1962 by the Sisters of Mercy, a Catholic Order of Nuns originating from Ireland, three years after registering themselves as the Registered Trustees of an entity under the Perpetual Succession Act (the succeeding legislation after independence). The "Sisters...read moreof Mercy" first set up a 60 bed general hospital to cater mainly for the poor, indigenous Kenyans, with the primary mission being general healthcare. The colonial authorities granted 12 acres of land in a swampy, mosquito-infested area, which has since become the Industrial Area of Nairobi. In 1970, a 60-bed maternity ward was opened with antenatal, postnatal and immunization clinics attached in order to upgrade the quality of maternity healthcare available to the poorer segments of the Nairobi population. In 1972, in recognition of the contribution of the hospital in training midwives to assist births in rural areas, Mater was chartered as a School of Midwifery. In 1975, a consultant’s block of 6 offices was opened enabling specialised consultants to practice on site and deliver significantly better medical services to the patients. In 1986, the hospital opened its own pharmacy, physiotherapy and laboratory services and, in 1990, opened its counselling centre for inpatients, outpatients and staff who needed advice and guidance on family planning, HIV, and other concerns of a psychological and/or physical nature. In 1995, in a major building expansion programme, the hospital opened a larger and more efficient Casualty, Accident and Emergency Department, an Intensive Care Unit and a Cardiac Unit where open-heart surgery is performed. The missionary role of the Sisters of Mercy has spread to other parts of Kenya and the Mater Hospital has become a private hospital that charges a fee-for-service to a patient population that has developed locally to a much higher level of affluence compared with other parts of Kenya. The financial objective of the hospital is to provide affordable healthcare to as many people as possible but also attempt to meet all of its costs, including depreciation, in order to replace and upgrade medical equipment.

Job Description:
About Role
As an Android Intern, you will improve the Branch Android app by building new features, optimizing performance, and contributing to the overall technical direction of the app.
You will work closely with other Android engineers, Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and Designers on various challenges and deliver a smooth and reliable user experience. You will take ownership of projects and features, driving them end-to-end from development to release. You will also suggest improvements, share ideas, and contribute to technical and architectural discussions.
As a company, we are passionate about our customers, fearless in the face of barriers, and driven by data. As an engineering team, we value bottom-up innovation and decentralized decision-making: We believe the best ideas can come from anyone in the company, and we are working hard to create an environment where everyone feels empowered to propose solutions to the challenges we face. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a fast-moving, innovative, and customer-focused setting.
Responsibilities
Building and improving features for the Branch Android app used by our customers. You will work on creating smooth, reliable, and user-friendly mobile experiences.
Working closely with backend teams to integrate APIs and support new product features. You will help ensure the Android app works seamlessly with backend systems and services.
Improving app performance, stability, and overall user experience. This includes fixing issues, reducing app crashes, and making the app faster and more reliable.
Working closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other engineers to understand requirements and deliver features end to end. You will support the team in successfully delivering its goals and initiatives.
Supporting integrations with third-party services such as payments, authentication systems, analytics, and marketing. You will help maintain and improve these integrations as the product grows.
Participating in code reviews, technical discussions, and team collaboration activities. You will contribute ideas, learn from others, and help maintain good engineering practices within the team.
Taking ownership of features and projects from development to release. You will be responsible for delivering quality work and ensuring a smooth rollout to users.
Contributing to improving code quality, testing, and maintainability of the Android codebase. You will help the team build a strong and scalable mobile application over time.
Qualifications
Have some experience building native Android applications that are more than just toy projects. Applications with real users or an open-source project would be a great plus.
You have a solid foundation in computer science fundamentals. Good understanding of Android development using Kotlin, along with modern Android development practices and frameworks.
Strong understanding of modern Android UI development using Jetpack Compose. Comfortable building responsive and scalable UI components, managing UI state, and following modern Android architecture and design patterns.
Experience building features that interact with REST APIs and backend services. Familiarity with third-party integrations such as authentication, analytics, payments, or messaging platforms is a plus.
Have a deep understanding of Android app performance, crash debugging, and improving app stability and reliability.
Curious about new technologies and interested in learning different parts of the technology stack beyond mobile development when needed.
Demonstrated fluency with modern AI-assisted development workflows and a point of view on their effectiveness for various use cases.
Clear, structured written and verbal communication, comfortable operating async effectively.
Core Engineering Expectations
The following describes the traits we expect in our engineers, and reflects instincts developed over years of shipping real software. If you are early in your career, we do not expect you to demonstrate all of it yet — but we do expect a genuine appreciation for why these qualities matter, an honest sense of where you stand against them, and the drive to close the gap.
Engineering craft and judgment
You balance technical excellence with business and consumer needs. You research and seek opinions to identify the best solution for a problem, not just the first one that comes to mind. You intentionally weigh technical debt, ensuring it is paid down before it compounds.
You have a deep understanding of web fundamentals, data modeling, and distributed systems. You apply proven design patterns to build modular, scalable solutions and ensure that security, performance, and observability are baked into your work from the outset.
You use automated testing as both a blueprint for clean architecture and a safety net for refactoring. You believe that well-designed code should be inherently testable, and you hold all contributions, whether human or AI generated, to the same standard of quality and maintainability.
You are comfortable navigating and evaluating unfamiliar codebases. You can integrate into and evolve existing architectures with care, researching thoroughly and seeking peer feedback to ensure your changes improve the system without breaking it.
You understand the full software development lifecycle. You can break down ambiguous projects into granular, estimable tasks that can be delegated effectively, ensuring a predictable and transparent path to delivery. You treat your delivery commitments as something the rest of the team plans against.
You consider the ripple effects of your work. You think critically about how your choices impact the end user, the business, and the team’s future velocity, and you have the drive to master the domain knowledge required to make those calls.
You partner with product, design, and other functions to shape the work, not just receive it. You push back when the spec is wrong, ask the question that reframes the problem, and share ownership of whether the thing was worth building in the first place.
AI proficiency
AI fluency is table stakes. You use AI to amplify your logic, not to replace it. You decompose ambiguous problems into clear steps and dependencies before prompting, ensuring you drive the architecture rather than allowing the AI to improvise a structure that compounds errors at high speed.
You hold AI-generated output to the same rigorous standards as human written code. You have the intuition to catch hallucinations of correctness, e.g. elegant looking code that fails subtly or tests that pass without actually asserting logic, and you take total accountability for the final implementation. Your trust is calibrated through experience; you can clearly articulate your technical reasoning whenever you choose to override an AI’s suggestion.
You manage tool context deliberately to avoid "model noise" and recognize the point of diminishing returns. You know exactly when to leverage a prompt to accelerate your workflow and when to step back to solve a high-complexity problem through deep, independent thought.
You proactively mitigate risks inherent to agentic workflows, including prompt injection, data leakage, and secret management. You treat AI-era security as a fundamental part of the engineering process, ensuring that "agentic" doesn't mean "unsecured."
You aggressively automate the mundane so your attention is reserved for the complex logic and design decisions that actually need a human.
You stay current with the evolving AI landscape and understand the underlying mechanics of the models and tools you use. You continuously raise your own productivity ceiling as the tools improve.
Operating principles
You make high-velocity, high-quality decisions. You move fast where the cost of being wrong is low and reversible, slow down where it isn't, and can articulate which mode you're in and why.
You are highly entrepreneurial and manage your own time, energy, and quality without oversight. You take the initiative to solve problems before they arise; nobody has to ask you twice, and often, nobody has to ask at all.
You are inherently curious and a high-velocity learner who handles setbacks without losing momentum. You possess the grit to keep moving when things go sideways and the judgment to know exactly when to pull in help to stay on track.
You have an uncompromising attention to detail. You catch the inconsistent behavior, the edge case bug, and the green test suite that doesn't actually verify anything, maintaining a high bar for the small things that define quality.
You simplify the complex. You write with the clarity of someone who expects to be read and ask the sharp, uncomfortable questions that often reveal hidden project risks.
You treat engineering as a team sport. You make those around you better through candid, helpful feedback, active listening, and a genuine commitment to helping your peers grow.
You're intellectually honest. You change your mind when you’re wrong, credit others when they’re right, and never defend a position or a design just because it’s yours.
You operate with integrity. You make the right call when no one is watching, raise concerns early when something feels off, and treat the trust placed in you — by users, teammates, and the business — as something to be earned every day.
You own what you ship. Architecting and writing the code is half the job. Testing, monitoring, documenting, and being on the hook when it breaks is the other half.
You bring discipline to how you work with others. You communicate in structured, async-friendly ways, keep your calendar and commitments reliable, and show up for shared responsibilities and rituals that keep the team functioning.
Benefits of Joining
Mission-driven, fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment
Competitive stipend as compensation
A collaborative and flat company culture
A job offer depending on your performance during the internship

Job Description:
About the Role
We are seeking a proactive, analytical and customer-focused Business System Support Analyst to join our ICT team.
The successful candidate will provide first-line support for the Temenos Transact (T24) core banking system and related digital banking applications. The role will support the investigation and resolution of system issues, application monitoring, user support, testing and deployment, data validation, reporting and continuous improvement of business systems.
The role will also play a key part in driving the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to improve operational efficiency, strengthen data analysis and support fraud detection.
Key Responsibilities
Business Applications Support
Provide first-level support to users of Temenos Transact (T24) and related business applications.
Log, investigate and resolve application incidents within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Troubleshoot issues relating to customer accounts, loans, deposits and financial transactions.
Monitor application availability and escalate complex issues to senior support teams or vendors.
Provide timely guidance and technical support to business users.
AI Adoption and Innovation
Support the adoption and effective use of AI across business operations.
Identify opportunities where AI can improve efficiency, productivity and decision-making.
Apply AI-driven tools and techniques to support fraud detection and risk management.
Use AI to enhance data analysis and generate actionable business insights.
Promote responsible AI awareness and best practices among users and ICT teams.
System Testing and Deployment
Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements.
Assist in validating system fixes and enhancements before production deployment.
Support post-deployment verification and monitoring.
Document and report system defects identified during testing.
System Monitoring
Monitor scheduled system jobs and batch processes.
Support End-of-Day (COB) and End-of-Month processing.
Identify and escalate system failures promptly.
Support recovery activities to minimize disruption to business operations.
Data Validation and Reporting
Conduct basic data validation and reconciliation.
Use SQL queries to investigate and verify application data.
Support preparation of operational and management reports.
Ensure accuracy and integrity of information used for decision-making.
Documentation and Knowledge Management
Maintain accurate records of incidents, resolutions and system issues.
Develop user guides, knowledge-base articles and support documentation.
Document recurring problems, root causes and recommended solutions.
Contribute to continuous improvement of application support processes.
Stakeholder Collaboration
Work closely with business users, ICT teams, software vendors and project teams.
Support application implementations, upgrades and system improvement initiatives.
Maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Key Performance Indicators
Success in this role will be measured through:
Timely resolution of application incidents within agreed SLAs.
High availability and reliability of supported business applications.
User satisfaction with ICT application support.
Successful testing and deployment of system enhancements.
Reduced post-deployment system defects.
Timely identification and escalation of system and batch-processing failures.
Accuracy of data validation and operational reports.
Effective adoption and application of AI solutions.
Improved efficiency and business insights through technology and data.
Quality and completeness of system documentation.
Qualifications and Experience
The ideal candidate should have:
A Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
Experience in application support, core banking systems, business systems or ICT service support.
Knowledge or experience working with Temenos Transact (T24) or similar core banking platforms will be an added advantage.
Basic to intermediate SQL and database querying skills.
Understanding of system testing, UAT and application deployment processes.
Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Understanding of IT service management and incident management principles.
Demonstrated interest or experience in AI, data analytics or automation will be an advantage.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical users.
High level of accuracy, integrity and accountability.
Job Field: Data, Business Analysis and AI,ICT / Computer

:

Job Title: Regional Technical, Evidence and Learning Director (TEQ)- Africa
Job Description:
Position Summary
The Regional Technical, Evidence and Learning Director (TEQ) is a key leadership role within the Africa Regional Program Team, responsible for strengthening technical excellence, evidence use, learning, innovation and program quality across Mercy Corps' portfolio in Africa. The Technical Director works closely with country teams, regional leadership, technical advisors and global programs and support teams to ensure country programs have access to the expertise, resources and systems needed to design, implement and adapt high-quality programs that achieve meaningful and sustainable impact. The Technical Director leads the regional technical team and serves as the primary focal point for technical resources, program quality standards, learning and technical capacity strengthening across the region. The role promotes the use of Mercy Corps' program models, technical frameworks and programming commitments to strengthen program effectiveness, improve outcomes, generate evidence and support organizational learning. The Technical Director also provides senior technical leadership for strategic business development opportunities and supports Mercy Corps' efforts to position itself as a recognized leader in delivering innovative, evidence-driven and locally-led programming across Africa.
Essential Responsibilities
STRATEGY & VISION
Support the development and implementation of an ambitious and compelling regional technical and evidence strategy for the consolidated Africa region, in alignment with the P2P framework, in close collaboration with regional and country teams across the region.
Support Country Teams across Africa in the successful development and implementation of their country strategies and annual implementation plans.
Work as a key partner to the Regional Programs Director to drive and implement an impactful regional strategy across the consolidated region.
Work closely with the Business Development Senior Advisors to ensure compelling proposals are submitted with high-quality technical input and designs that draw on Mercy Corps’ evidence base.
Promote collaboration and close coordination between Technical, Evidence and Quality (TEQ) teams to ensure technical inputs feed into the Global and/or Regional Evidence and Learning Agenda, program strategies, program models and country learning priorities across the region.
TEAM LEADERSHIP & MANAGEMENT
Supervise the Regional Technical Advisors — including the Market Systems Development Advisor, GESI Advisor and MEL Advisors (x2) — and create a collaborative, accountable, high-performing regional technical team that delivers timely and quality support to programs.
Develop efficient systems to identify support needs of country teams and ensure that programs access quality, relevant and timely support from Global and Regional Program Support teams.
Line manage and support select Regional Programs to support high quality program start-up and delivery, consistent donor engagement and compliance, strategic business development and growth, and evidence generation and dissemination.
Foster strong collaboration between country teams, regional technical resources and Global Programs & Support teams.
Support succession planning and professional development for regional technical talent.
Fill in as needed for either Regional Programs Director, Program Leadership, and field leadership during leave and/or leadership gaps as necessary.
PROGRAM SUPPORT & QUALITY
Ensure country teams have access to technical support and resources to deliver quality-based and technically sound programs across the humanitarian-development-peace nexus.
Ensure all programs adhere to minimum program management standards, technical standards and best practices, and disseminate and promote new tools and guidance developed by global teams.
Promote consistent quality assurance processes and technical review mechanisms throughout the program lifecycle.
Lead capacity strengthening and learning initiatives across Africa to ensure country teams continue expanding their technical knowledge and expertise over time, in close coordination with TEQ teams.
Identify opportunities to scale promising practices, innovative approaches and proven models across country programs.
Support country teams to strengthen program design, implementation, adaptation and scale through technically sound and evidence-based approaches.
Foster stronger linkages between country programs, regional technical priorities and global technical leadership to maximize learning, consistency and impact across the Africa portfolio.
Monitor trends in program quality across the portfolio and support targeted improvement initiatives where required.
PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT, DESIGN, AND IMPLEMENTATION
Work closely with global, regional and country teams on any new business opportunities that require strong technical leadership, input, and review.
Support regional and country teams across Africa to identify, explore, and pursue funding opportunities that support regional and country technical strategy objectives, including promoting Mercy Corps’ program models in design processes.
Support — and when relevant, lead — the development of evidence-based technical concept notes, proposals, and other funding requests, ensuring quality submissions that maximize chances for success, including sourcing internal or external technical expertise to assist, in close collaboration with the Business Development Senior Advisors.
Position Mercy Corps for strategic funding opportunities that build on country and/or regional programmatic priorities and technical excellence across the region.
Work closely with global program support units to ensure resources are available to country teams when needed and to facilitate continuous quality improvement of field programs, especially during rapid growth.
PREPOSITIONING, BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & REPRESENTATION
Play an active and visible role in prepositioning efforts across Africa, working alongside country and regional teams to engage donors and partners ahead of funding opportunities, strengthen Mercy Corps’ positioning, and build the technical credibility of the organization in the region.
Represent Mercy Corps in donor meetings, technical working groups, inter-agency coordination forums, and other external events as required, showcasing the organization’s technical expertise, evidence base, and program impact across the consolidated region.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with donors, UN agencies, research institutions, private sector actors, and other partners relevant to Mercy Corps’ technical priorities in Africa.
Support the development of technical positioning papers, capacity statements, and other materials that strengthen Mercy Corps’ profile with key donors and partners across the region while ensuring dissemination to these technical documents to the right stakeholders, both internally and externally.
Provide technical input and leadership during proposal development processes, ensuring that BD submissions draw on the latest evidence, reflect programmatic learning, and demonstrate Mercy Corps’ distinctive technical value, in close collaboration with the Business Development Senior Advisors and country teams.
EVIDENCE AND LEARNING
Oversee MEL technical support across the regions and serve as a key enabler for advancing the regional Evidence and Learning (E&L) Agenda and/or priorities and assessing program performance.
Act as a bridge between technical and MEL functions, promoting integration and coherence in program design, implementation, and review.
Lead coordination between technical advisors and MEL counterparts to ensure that programs generate, document, and use evidence effectively.
Champion the use of evidence in business development opportunities, decision-making and adaptive management across all regional and country-level programs.
Support regional technical and MEL communities of practice and joint learning initiatives spanning the region.
Support and contribute to research-specific opportunities in the region, from design stage to implementation and evaluation.
Champion evidence-driven programming and promote the systematic use of data, research and learning to improve program performance and decision-making.
Foster collaboration and knowledge exchange across country programs to strengthen learning and replication of successful approaches.
Support the generation, documentation and dissemination of evidence, lessons learned and promising practices from programs across Africa.
SYSTEMS & PLANNING
Develop and implement internal systems for tracking technical support requests, priorities, and deliverables across the region.
Maintain a detailed planning system to cost technical advisors appropriately across country and regional programs and oversee the development of all related administrative aspects (SoWs, Budgets, etc.).
Work closely with the Regional Programs Director and regional operations teams to align technical resource planning and budgeting across the consolidated region.
REPRESENTATION & COORDINATION
Ensure program coordination and information sharing within and between regional and country teams across Africa, to maximize efficiency and cross-learning.
Represent the region in Global Programs & Support working groups, while amplifying regional and country technical needs to advocate for additional support.
Identify and pursue areas for thought leadership, including building connections with donors, private sector partners, academia and other actors, showcasing Mercy Corps’ program impact and promoting the region’s capabilities, expertise, innovation, strategic vision, and values.
SAFEGUARDING RESPONSIBILITIES
Actively learns about safeguarding and integrates it into their work, including safeguarding risks and mitigations related to their area of work.
Practices the values of Mercy Corps including respecting the dignity and well-being of participants and fellow team members.
Encourages openness and communication in their team; encourages team members to submit reports if they have any concerns using reporting mechanisms e.g., Integrity Hotline and other options.
Supervisory Responsibility
Regional Technical Advisors across Africa, comprising: Regional MSD Advisor; GESI Advisor; MEL Advisors (x2); and any other technical advisors joining the regional team over time. Supervise Regional Programs as assigned and agreed.
Accountability to Participants and Stakeholders
Mercy Corps team members are expected to support all efforts toward accountability, specifically to our program participants, community partners, other stakeholders, and to international standards guiding international relief and development work. We are committed to actively engaging communities as equal partners in the design, monitoring and evaluation of our field projects.
Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Detailed understanding of the finance, operations and administration mechanisms that support a grant/project implementation life cycle.
Demonstrated ability to think strategically, and to solve complex problems at an organizational level.
Confident communication skills applicable to donor relations, prepositioning, and inter-agency coordination.
Ability to handle multiple issues at one time, especially in emergency situations, and to organize and prioritize accordingly.
